name: Lantronix, Inc.
summary: Lantronix, Inc. develops, markets, and sells industrial and enterprise internet of things (IoT) products and services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific Japan. The company's embedded IoT solutions provides embedded products, including compute system-on-module and system-in-package solutions; and application processing solutions for data transformation, computer vision, machine learning, augmented/virtual reality, audio/video aggregation and distribution, and custom applications.
